name: agent-device-hub
description: Shared hub architecture and development workflow bootstrap

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/lifecycle-contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/agent-state/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/agent-status/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/hub/tsconfig.json && tsc -p controllers/tidbyt/tsconfig.json && tsc -p controllers/lifx/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/local-controllers/tsconfig.json && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/lifecycle-contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-state/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-status/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/hub/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p controllers/tidbyt/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:dashboard && tsc -p controllers/lifx/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/local-controllers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && npm run test:contracts:built
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built

scripts.test:hub: npm run build && npm run test:hub:built
scripts.test:hub:package: npm run build && npm run test:hub:package:built
